units.source_text: 夕雾对她说道：“从很久以前开始，我对你的爱情就已与众不同。

en.t: Yugiri said to her, "From long ago, my love for you has been unlike anyone else's.

units.source_text: 你父亲对我态度冷酷，使我在世间获得了愚夫的恶名。

en.t: Your father treated me coldly, and because of that I gained the shameful name of a foolish husband in the world.

units.source_text: 但我竭力忍受这难堪的痛苦，各处争来说亲，一概置之不闻。

en.t: But I did my utmost to endure that unbearable pain, and when marriage proposals came eagerly from every side, I ignored them all.

units.source_text: 众人都讥笑我，说即使是女子，也不会如此固执。

en.t: Everyone laughed at me, saying that even a woman would not be so stubborn.

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，不知那时怎么能够忍受的，

en.t: Looking back on it now, I do not know how I was able to bear it then,

units.source_text: 我自己也相信我从小就是一个稳重的人。

en.t: and I myself believe that I have been a steady person since childhood.

units.source_text: 现在你虽然如此讨厌我，但你已经有了一大群不能抛开的孩子，

en.t: Now, though you hate me so much, you already have a large number of children whom you cannot abandon,

units.source_text: 不能独断独行地离弃我了。

en.t: so you can no longer leave me behind by acting on your own judgment alone.

units.source_text: 请你放长眼光，静观将来！

en.t: Please take the long view and quietly watch what the future brings!
The only thing to fear is the uncertainty of human life."
Having said this much, he suddenly began to weep.

units.source_text: 云居雁回思昔年之事，也不胜感慨，觉得自己同他真是世间少有的夫妇，宿世因缘毕竟是很深的。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari thought back on the events of earlier years and was deeply moved, feeling that she and he were truly a rare couple in this world, and that the bond from their former lives was, after all, very deep.

units.source_text: 夕雾把那件软熟了的家常衣服脱下，换上一件特别华丽的新衣，熏足了衣香，用心打扮，仔细化妆，准备出门去了。

en.t: Yugiri took off the soft, well-worn everyday robe, changed into a particularly splendid new one, steeped it thoroughly in fragrance, dressed himself with care, applied his makeup carefully, and prepared to go out.

units.source_text: 云居雁在灯火影里目送他，忍不住流下泪来。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari watched him go in the lamplight and could not hold back her tears.

units.source_text: 便扯过夕雾脱下的单衣的衣袖来拭泪，自言自语地吟道：

en.t: She pulled over the sleeve of the unlined robe Yugiri had taken off, wiped her tears with it, and murmured this poem to herself:
